mapper.select: SELECT category, COUNT(*) as id FROM knowledge_points GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
SELECT * FROM knowledge_points WHERE article_count > 0 ORDER BY importance_score DESC, article_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT kp.* FROM knowledge_points kp INNER JOIN article_knowledge_relation akr ON kp.id = akr.knowledge_point_id WHERE akr.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY akr.relevance DESC
